findings.claim: FY2026 前十大客戶占淨銷售 49%（FY2025 43%、FY2024 40%）；Climate Solutions 一家全球科技客戶約占 11%，FY2025、FY2024 無單一客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers, some of which are conglomerates or otherwise affiliated with one another, accounted for 49 percent of our consolidated net sales in fiscal 2026. In fiscal 2026, one global technology customer in our Climate Solutions segment accounted for approximately 11 percent of our sales.

findings.claim: 2026-03-31 應收帳款 53% 來自前十大客戶（前一年 43%）；公司通常不要求擔保或預付款，未發生重大信用損失。
findings.excerpt: At March 31, 2026 and 2025, 53 percent and 43 percent, respectively, of the Company’s trade accounts receivable were due from the Company’s top ten customers. These customers operate primarily in the data center, commercial vehicle, off-highway, commercial air conditioning and refrigeration, and automotive and light vehicle markets. The Company generally does not require collateral or advanced payments from its customers. The Company has not experienced significant credit losses to customers in the markets served.

findings.claim: 風險因素揭露：資料中心、Gensets 等領域大部分銷售來自少數客戶，失去主要客戶或訂單量顯著下滑會對業績與現金流造成不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In certain areas of our businesses, including data centers, Gensets, and some portions of our vehicular businesses, a large portion of sales are attributable to a relatively small number of customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱預期 2027–2029 年對單一資料中心客戶銷售逾 40 億美元但無購買保證（搜尋摘要轉述）。
findings.excerpt: capacity agreement with one of our strategic data center customers, with whom we are party to a confidentiality agreement. In connection with this capacity agreement, we received a $165 million up-front deposit from the customer to support investments necessary to meet the planned sales volume. We expect to sell more than $4 billion of data center cooling products to this customer
